tagline: 美能达便携相机，1987 年发布
description: 美能达于1987年推出的便携相机。配备35 mm f/4,5 (4 elements/4 groups).。使用Automatic loading, advance and rewind.。感光度0,95—3,3 m.。Infrared [autofocus] from 0,95 m to infinity.。

specs.闪光灯: Built-in, automatically activated with ready-light in finder. Shutter locked while recharging.
specs.曝光测光: EV 9,6–16,2 with ISO 100 film. Narrow metering angle.
specs.英文简介: Minolta AF-E II (called Freedom 200 in America) is an autofocus compact camera and a simplified successor model to the original AF-E.
